notes: Hand-picked: the birds of the granitic islands (Mahé, Praslin, La Digue, Cousin, Aride, Bird and Denis), with their seabirds and the waders on the shores from October to April, plus the three Aldabra endemics for the endemics chapter. Other Aldabra-only birds are dropped, and so is Comoro Blue-Pigeon, which the database marks endemic but also lives on the Comoros.
